domain-information: A Conference Organizer selects the conference theme and sets the program to attract relevant professionals
A Conference Organizer coordinates venue bookings and catering to ensure the event runs smoothly
A Speaker prepares a presentation on emerging industry trends to educate and inspire attendees
A Speaker submits session materials in advance to allow organizers to review and include them in the conference program
An Attendee registers online and selects preferred sessions to customize their conference experience
An Attendee provides feedback after sessions to help improve future conferences
A Session Moderator introduces speakers and manages Q&A to keep sessions on track and engaging
A Session Moderator collects audience questions to highlight the most relevant topics for discussion
A Sponsor negotiates branding opportunities to showcase products and services to attendees
A Sponsor holds networking events to connect with potential clients and industry partners
A Conference Coordinator monitors registrations and sends reminders to ensure high attendance
A Conference Coordinator arranges transportation and accommodation information for out-of-town participants

domain objects.name: Conference Organizer
domain objects.description: person responsible for planning and coordinating the overall conference

domain objects.name: Conference
domain objects.description: the full event that includes theme, agenda, and program

domain objects.name: Theme
domain objects.description: central topic that defines the conference focus

domain objects.name: Agenda
domain objects.description: planned schedule of sessions and activities

domain objects.name: Conference Program
domain objects.description: collection of sessions and events included in the conference

domain objects.name: Venue Booking
domain objects.description: arrangement securing the physical location for the conference

domain objects.name: Catering
domain objects.description: coordination of food and beverage services for the event

domain objects.name: Speaker
domain objects.description: person presenting content or expertise at a session

domain objects.name: Attendee
domain objects.description: participant registered to join the conference

domain objects.name: Feedback
domain objects.description: attendee input on sessions or overall conference quality

domain objects.name: Session Moderator
domain objects.description: person leading the session flow and managing audience interaction

domain objects.name: Session
domain objects.description: individual event block featuring a speaker and presentation

domain objects.name: Audience Question
domain objects.description: question submitted by attendees during a session

domain objects.name: Presentation
domain objects.description: speaker delivered talk or visual material

domain objects.name: Session Material
domain objects.description: supporting files or documents submitted by speakers

domain objects.name: Sponsor
domain objects.description: organization supporting the conference for visibility and networking

domain objects.name: Branding Negotiation
domain objects.description: discussion between organizer and sponsor about promotional opportunities

domain objects.name: Networking Event
domain objects.description: interactive gathering for attendees and sponsors to connect

domain objects.name: Registration
domain objects.description: attendee sign up process for conference participation

domain objects.name: Reminder
domain objects.description: notification sent to attendees regarding upcoming conference details

domain objects.name: Accommodation Information
domain objects.description: details provided to help attendees arrange lodging for the event

associations.description: Conference Organizer oversees the planning and setup of the Conference
Conference Organizer defines and structures the Conference Program
Conference Organizer arranges Catering for the event
Conference Organizer manages the Venue Booking needed for the Conference
Conference Organizer participates in Branding Negotiation for sponsor visibility
Session Moderator facilitates and manages the flow of the Session
Session Moderator coordinates with the Speaker during the Session
Speaker presents content and contributes expertise in the Session
Speaker creates and delivers the Presentation
Conference Organizer reviews and prepares Session Material for inclusion
Sponsor engages in Branding Negotiation to secure exposure
Sponsor hosts or contributes to a Networking Event
Attendee completes a Registration to join the Conference
Registration links an Attendee to a chosen Session
Registration includes options for joining a Networking Event
Conference Coordinator monitors and manages each Registration
Conference Coordinator sends a Reminder related to the Conference
Reminder reaches the Attendee with important updates
Conference Coordinator provides Accommodation Information for participants
Accommodation Information supports the Attendee with travel planning
Attendee submits Feedback after participating
Feedback informs the Conference Organizer about attendee experience
